name: hud_recti_clip_or_split_segment
description: HudRectI::ClipOrSplitSegment accepts, rejects, clips, or splits a map segment against a HUD rectangle using outcodes and edge-intersection helpers.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x415fb0 validates the zero-width accept, inside return 0, common-outcode reject return 1, one-outside clipping through edge-intersection checks, and split return 2 with g_HudSensor_ClipSegmentStart/End; HLIL has a documented fastcall/x87 rendering artifact around SegmentIntersectsEdge call sites.
The native rect-clip helper smoke verifies zero-width, inside, same-side reject, one-outside clipping, and split behavior including the global split segment start.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 --explain-missing 0x415fb0 reported no VC verification target currently covers this address.
